blocks.text: CLEVELAND–James Harden scored 51 points as the Cleveland Cavaliers defeated the Indiana Pacers 128-119 in an NBA Cup game on Friday night. It was the 18-year veteran guard’s 26th 50-point game, passing the late Kobe Bryant for third-most 50-point games in NBA history. It was Harden’s first since he had 55 points for the Los Angeles Clippers against the Charlotte Hornets on Nov. 22, 2025. READ: NBA: James Harden ends slow start this season with throwback game Harden is the sixth player to have a 50-point game for Cleveland.
